prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: NEW production source pixel-art animation sheet for Rattle Norvegicus, an uncanny rat-mask girl who is a professional acrobatic wrestler wearing a wizard costume.
Input images: Image 1 is the character identity reference (rat-wizard attempt 09). Image 2 is the STRICT native chunky pixel rendering reference of the actual tiny runtime sprites. Image 3 is the original game's pixel art style reference. Reuse her grey horrid theatrical rat-mask, sunken eyes, black projecting snout, reddish mouth with tooth pixels, auburn hair, tall green cone hat, and navy wizard cloak with restrained gold edging. Keep these recognizable in every pose. Her cloak opens/swirls during kicks to show trousered human legs and small boots; fully clothed.
Primary request: ONE square 8-column by 8-row sprite sheet, exactly 64 evenly spaced FULL BODY action frames. Animate real physical professional wrestling, no staff, no gun, no projectiles, no spell flame. All actions face right where applicable. Fit EVERY pose inside its own equal square cell, including the cone hat and outstretched legs. Same character scale throughout. Standing height approximately 27 native pixels; widest splits approximately 28 native pixels. Large hard square pixels, crisp single native-pixel dark contour, 2-3 flat shade clusters, restrained 16-color palette, no fine details, no anti-aliasing or gradients. Make it look like hand-drawn 32x32 game sprites enlarged with nearest neighbor, not a detailed illustration.
Exact rows, eight consecutive poses each from left to right:
Row 1: GROUND DROPKICK: guarded crouch, launch, both legs extend forward RIGHT, airborne horizontal two-boot kick, boots fully striking, legs retract, feet land, standing recovery.
Row 2: spinning heel kick: winding torso, lifting one knee, turning, one boot sweeping right, extended side kick, follow through, land, guard.
Row 3: FRONT SALTO: upright takeoff, tuck forward, body rotates sideways, UPSIDE DOWN hat below body, horizontal rolled pose, legs unfold, boot points right, landing. A coherent complete 360-degree somersault, genuine upside-down silhouettes in middle frames.
Row 4: SPLITS STOMP: air tuck, both legs opening laterally, wide airborne straddle split with one boot LEFT and the other RIGHT, arms up and cloak parted, wide split descending, low split stomp impact with both boots sideways, seated split, start recovery. Both legs must be visible and span the full width; NOT an ordinary crouch or standing cast.
Row 5: split-impact RECOVERY: low wide splits, compression, legs fold under body, one-knee kneel, pushing up with hands, crouch, rise, standing rat-wizard guard.
Row 6: wrestler victory taunt: arms flex, fist high, lean forward, chest out, arms spread, boastful rat snarl, arms lower, guard.
Row 7: aerial flying kick: crouch, takeoff, tuck, forward somersault, one or two extended boots right, kick follows through, land, guard.
Row 8: wrestling hurt and fall: recoil, lean back, topple, lying sideways still wearing hat, lying, arm pushup, knee rise, guarded stance.
Composition: exact 8x8 orthogonal regular cells, no text, no labels, no visible grid, no watermark, no borders, no floor lines or scenery. Genuine transparent background, no checkerboard drawn into artwork and no shadows beneath feet. No other characters. Preserve grotesque theatrical rat head; do not turn her into a cute mouse or bird.
